events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You are talking to an AI agent acting on behalf of the Halcyon Components IT service desk. 

I am not allowed to share which AI vendor or model powers this service, and I haven't been given information on whether a person is monitoring this chat or who can see the conversation. 

If you would prefer to speak directly with a person on the IT service desk, you can reach them at extension 4400 between 7am and 7pm. Otherwise, if you'd like me to reset your password, please let me know your employee ID.
